children: is stepping up its investment in India's international financial hub, GIFT City, Bloomberg News reported, citing global co-head of payments, Max Neukirchen.
The Wall Street lender opened its GIFT City branch in 2022, the report noted.
"We've been there for four years now and have a few hundred clients there, with the business growing substantially," Neukirchen told Bloomberg TV.
